question: Whether cache-off fixed 8192-input/1024-output AWQ/vLLM/L40S serving has a resource- and SLO-admissible concurrency point beyond c8.

v21_session_telemetry.scope: whole retained V21 session; not isolated to c8

points.caveat: The thin 11.57% capacity margin has not been validated against runtime reserve or fragmentation.

scheduler_and_slo_bound.interpretation: This is a deliberately conservative scheduling proxy based on V21 c8 p95 TTFT, not a performance prediction. It admits one c16 falsification with only 97.25 ms nominal TTFT slack and rejects c32 under the unchanged 65,536-token budget. Chunked-prefill interleaving must be measured, not assumed beneficial.

economics_and_peak_gate.interpretation: A c16 arm is decision-relevant only if its conservative full-batch throughput reaches 397.28 output tok/s; SLO passing alone is not a promotion.

blocking_gaps: vllm_batched_runner.py measures only c1 and c8 and fixes the profiler batch at c8.
vllm_recover_existing.py exposes no max-num-seqs argument and therefore cannot propagate c16.
The current artifact manifest has raw per-request profiles and telemetry, but no c16/c32 profile contract or scheduler iteration-state capture.
runner_readiness.minimum_preregistered_change: Add one arm-scoped max-num-seqs parameter propagated through remote launch, retained-server recovery, and performance profiles; retain c1 and an adjacent c8 control, then add c16. Keep max-num-batched-tokens at 65536, model/runtime/dtype/checkpoint/generation/prefix state/seed/quality capture fixed. Do not schedule c32 in this first session.

required_c16_artifact_contract: server command and loaded KV-cache capacity evidence
c1, adjacent c8, and c16 raw per-request rows with exact token geometry
metrics deltas for queue, TTFT, TPOT, and prefix-cache counters
one-hertz GPU utilization, VRAM, power, and allocation/useful-GPU timing
scheduler running/waiting/KV evidence sufficient to distinguish an admission wave from decode saturation
semantic and existing prospective paired-quality/NLL gates
full allocation exposure, cost, watchdog, and verified teardown
